text:
The plan needs one fix. Remove the top-level `"timeline"` key.

The output must be exactly one JSON object with only the `"modules"` and `"order"` keys. The `timeline` block isn't part of the required schema. It also invents a specific security review date (2026-11-30) and a rollout gate that the notes never set as requirements.

Everything else already satisfies the requirements, so leave it unchanged.
